summary: A Saudi law office with Riyadh and Jeddah branches appears to lose international clients to a free builder address, a generic page title and a free mail address.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address makes a law office look temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.problem: The page title appears to read HOME Mysite.
findings.cost: A default title means search results do not name the firm.
findings.fix: A title with the firm name and city.

findings.problem: The contact email appears to be a yahoo.com address instead of one on the firm's own domain.
findings.cost: A free mail address makes international clients doubt the firm.
findings.fix: An email address on your own domain.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears next to the contact details.
findings.cost: Many clients in Saudi Arabia prefer to message first, and a firm that replies on WhatsApp first wins the consultation.
